user.title: MyHeat Account
user.description: Please obtain API key from https://my.myheat.net on user preferences page

data.local_enabled: Use local connection (fallback when the cloud is down)

local.title: Local connection to the controller
local.description: Address and credentials of the controller web interface. Defaults are myheat/myheat. Poll interval and timeout can stay as they are - the controller is slow.

reauth_confirm.title: New MyHeat API key
reauth_confirm.description: The MyHeat cloud no longer accepts the key. Enter your login and a new API key (my.myheat.net → Settings → Profile). History and entities are kept.

error.cannot_connect_local: Cannot reach the controller. Check IP, login and password.
error.device_not_found: No controller of this integration was found for this key — check the account.

init.title: Local connection settings
init.description: Changed without removing the integration — history and entities are kept. The integration reloads after saving. Cloud login/API key cannot be changed here (that is a different account — add the integration again).

data.gas_rate: Average gas flow while the burner runs
data.gas_rate_min: Gas flow at minimum power (0 % modulation)
data.gas_rate_max: Gas flow at full power (100 % modulation)

data_description.gas_rate: Gas = burner time × this flow. Used when the range below is not set, and while modulation is unknown. Empty = no gas estimate.
data_description.gas_rate_min: From the boiler manual (Protherm Gepard 24: 1.05). With both minimum and maximum set, gas follows the burner modulation from the MyHeat cloud.
data_description.gas_rate_max: From the boiler manual (Protherm Gepard 24: 2.80). Only the cloud reports modulation: without it the average flow is used, or the middle of the range if that is empty.

error.cannot_connect_local: Cannot reach the controller. Check IP, login and password.
error.cloud_creds_required: This integration was added in local-only mode — there are no cloud credentials. To enable cloud, remove and re-add the integration with login and API key.
error.gas_range_invalid: Set both ends of the gas range — minimum and maximum (maximum not below minimum) — or leave both empty.
